key_features: Landing Page with hero cursor parallax, stats ticker, and quick portal links
Multi-lingual support (English, Hindi, Bengali) with instant state switcher
Complete Light/Dark mode toggle with persistent state
Local demo authentication with localStorage persistence & instant demo login buttons
Farmer Dashboard: stats, quick actions, recent activity, earnings chart
Buyer Dashboard: saved produce, active orders, escrow pipeline
Marketplace with 15 real agricultural crops, multi-filters (State, District, Quality Grade A/B/Organic, Price range), search, and sorting
Product Details Modal & Make Offer modal with price negotiation
Create Produce Listing Form with live preview
My Produce Management (Edit, Delete, Pause status)
Buyer Offers Table with Accept, Reject, Counter offer actions
Orders Pipeline & Consignments Table with Demo Escrow system
Market Prices Board (DEMO ₹/kg across key Indian mandis)
Market Intelligence interactive analytics and trends
User Profile with custom local image picker and initials avatar fallback
Support & FAQs, Settings, and Notification center with sonner toasts

image_urls.description: Fresh Indian agricultural marketplace produce showcase
Harvest bags in fields / agricultural mandi market prices

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust Single Page React App (SPA) in /app/frontend with tab/route state and interactive modals matching all user requirements and design system specifications. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes and support English, Hindi, and Bengali.
